title: Life-Harness 自動診斷受控工程驗收

verification_outcome.summary:
依提供的程式快照與補交原生紀錄，唯讀查核通過。紀錄支持缺失模組失敗、服務提示、三次獨立 prepare／原樣 receipt／readback，以及讀回後才新增模組的順序；先前缺口已補足。程式符合統計與輸入驗證需求，5 項合法及 25 項非法測試有實質覆蓋。
工作樹根目錄可使用：node tools/lh-auto-acceptance/cli.mjs '[]'；測試：node --test tools/lh-auto-acceptance/acceptance.test.mjs。
本次僅查閱傳入資料，未讀盤、重算雜湊或執行測試。歷史診斷僅 nativeClaimBindingVerified=true，其餘三項仍為 false，不能宣稱完整診斷成功。Runtime 固定測試、檔案一致性核對與正式保存仍待執行，本判決不代表結案。

original_scope: 真實 native shell 初次重現缺失相對模組；若收到自動 Life-Harness 提示，必須分別執行 prepare、原樣 receipt command、readback，保留結果並在 readback 後修復。入口對合法資料輸出正確三項統計，不合法輸入以非零退出且不輸出成功結果。Node 測試通過，獨立 verifier 核對後由既有 Runtime 執行固定测试並正式保存。診斷失敗與工程成果完成必須分開報告，不得聲稱未取得的證據。
verification_method: Formal verifier reviewed complete source snapshots and retained native historical sequence; coordinator checked forwarded snapshots against current bytes; existing Runtime independently executed its fixed Node tests and adopted the result.
remaining_environment_issue: Windows sandbox file/tool startup failed in the verifier; it was not repaired or disabled. Source snapshot review was used as the bounded alternative.
historical_diagnostic_limits: Advisory only; nativeClaimBindingVerified=true, producerVerified=false, inputFileBytesVerified=false, diagnosticSemanticsVerified=false. No full diagnostic success is claimed.
